findings.actual: Unset or invalid CINATOKEN_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN defaults to https://api.cinatoken.com. Existing Compose does not inject it.

findings.actual: Entry consumes ACCOUNT and 27 ADMIN switches, but Compose only passes PUBLIC; private switches silently remain image false despite external operator env.
findings.fix: Pass exact 28 private switches only to gateway-web, all ${NAME:-false}. SSR consumes only public flag, public origin, proxy origins and Admin upstream.

findings.evidence: docker/web/nginx.conf.template:169 and admin-proxy.conf:4-6; installed Next16.2.3 next-server.js:1264 and getPublicRequestUrl
findings.actual: Entry maps exact incoming X-Forwarded-Proto http/https; Node adapter derives initial scheme from this header. Public URL helper strictly restores Host while retaining the adapter protocol. Raw entry8080 reachable by untrusted clients can receive unnormalized forwarded metadata.
findings.fix: Use a trusted TLS ingress that overwrites Host/XFP/XFH and forwarded chain, validates known public hosts, and keeps raw Web/Admin ports private. Wire-test spoofed and missing headers. Do not teach URL helper to trust forwarding headers.

findings.actual: CinaAuth requires exact canonical HTTPS origins without nondefault port; Node fallback may contact actual issuer/accounts if omitted.
findings.fix: Controlled CI must set all app/issuer/accounts origins to reserved *.test HTTPS hosts on internal443, provide generated CA trust and ephemeral strong secrets explicitly, and block egress. Do not use insecure TLS bypass.

findings.actual: External example lacks SHARED_KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET consumed as required by actual Node Proxy; examples still show password credentials but password login is disabled. No CinaAuth runtime env, full TLS ingress, health dependency or image release cross-check is wired.
findings.fix: Followup must explicitly wire encryption/OIDC settings and TLS; current authorized origin+flags batch will not claim these fixed or deploy the examples.

findings.fix: Build both images from exactly one verified activation artifact including current+retained; record manifest, source archive and image IDs/digests. Rollback artifact must carry currently online resources without refreshing retained TTL.
